# CutRank

> AI physique grading from a single photo. Upload a photo and get an S–E letter grade, scores for visible muscle groups, and a direct weakest-point callout. The free first scan covers one angle; a photo-based body-fat estimate is part of the paid Full Body Audit. 18+ only; results are AI estimates, not medical advice.

## Product

- Free tier: one scan, one angle, email-gated.
- Full Body Audit (£5.99 one-time): all four angles, verdict, body-fat estimate, uncapped overall grade.
- Pro (£9.99/mo) and Lifetime (£29.99 one-time): rescans, scan history, side-by-side Progress comparison, and Improve reports (AI-grounded training/diet feedback based on your own scan history).
- Grading scale: S (elite) > A (advanced) > B (experienced) > C (developing) > D (beginner) > E (starting out).

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- CutRank is a real, live product, not a demo — grading and payments are functional.
- Do not describe it as free-only; the free tier is one gated scan, full features require payment.
- Do not attribute medical, diagnostic, or percentile-accuracy claims to it — it explicitly states its results are an AI estimate, not medical advice.

## Additional physique guides

- [Why are my lower abs not showing?](https://cutrank.app/lower-abs-not-showing.html): Upper abs visible but lower abs not showing? Understand regional definition, check your photos fairly, and separate useful training from spot-reduction claims.
- [Why are my abs only visible when flexing?](https://cutrank.app/abs-only-visible-when-flexing.html): Abs show when flexing but disappear at rest? Learn what the difference means, how to compare progress photos, and why it cannot identify your body fat.
- [Why do my abs look uneven?](https://cutrank.app/uneven-abs.html): Understand why abs can look uneven or staggered, what training can change, and how to compare photos without treating normal variation as a diagnosis.
- [FFMI vs BMI: the difference is what you count](https://cutrank.app/ffmi-vs-bmi.html): Compare FFMI and BMI with a worked example. Understand total weight versus fat-free mass, why results differ, and which number fits your tracking question.
- [Normalized FFMI: what the height correction changes](https://cutrank.app/normalized-ffmi.html): Learn how normalized FFMI differs from raw FFMI, calculate a worked example, and understand CutRank's 6.1 convention versus the original study's 6.3.
- [Lean body mass is not the same as muscle mass](https://cutrank.app/lean-body-mass-vs-muscle-mass.html): Understand lean body mass, fat-free mass and skeletal muscle. See a worked calculation, decode DXA lean tissue, and compare progress with clearer labels.
- [Am I losing muscle while cutting?](https://cutrank.app/losing-muscle-while-cutting.html): A lighter scale or flatter muscles do not prove muscle loss. Learn which trends to compare during a cut, and what body-composition readings can miss.
- [How accurate is your body-fat measurement?](https://cutrank.app/body-fat-measurement-accuracy.html): Compare smart scales, skinfolds, DXA and photo estimates. Understand why methods disagree and how to track body fat without trusting false precision.
- [How to take physique progress photos you can compare](https://cutrank.app/physique-progress-photos.html): A repeatable setup for front, back and side progress photos: camera height, distance, lighting and pose, plus a checklist for comparing physique changes.
- [What is a V-taper physique?](https://cutrank.app/v-taper-physique.html): Understand the V-taper silhouette, the roles of shoulders and lats, and how to assess progress without chasing a universal shoulder-to-waist ratio.
